chronology.text: On 1 July 2025, Buhay Hardware Supply, Inc. and Tanchingco Builders executed a Supply Agreement providing for payment within thirty days from delivery and interest of 1.5% per month on overdue invoices.
Between October 2025 and February 2026, plaintiff delivered materials covered by invoices 2025-0912, 2025-1044 and 2026-0117 with an aggregate principal of PHP 1,875,400.00.
On 12 March 2026, defendant acknowledged an outstanding balance in a Viber exchange and undertook to pay upon release of a government progress billing.
Written demand dated 20 April 2026 was received at defendant's office on 21 April 2026. No payment has been received since.

contradictions.claim: Statement of account lists invoice 2026-0117 as overdue by 88 days as of 30 April 2026.
contradictions.against: Delivery receipts for that invoice are dated 5 February 2026.
contradictions.observation: The overdue count appears to run from delivery rather than from the end of the thirty day term. Confirm the reckoning before the computation is attached to the complaint.
